sections.title: Common Questions About Google Business Profile
sections.description: Get answers to the most common questions about our Google Business Profile services.

faqs.question: Why should I claim my listing?
faqs.answer: By claiming your profile, you gain control over the information displayed by Google. Without claiming your listing, Google may inaccurately present details about your business, potentially leading to misinformation and missed sales opportunities.

faqs.question: What if I do not have access to the previous owner's account for the business?
faqs.answer: Regaining access can take some extra steps such as providing additional documentation to prove your ownership. We have experience working with Google to get new owners properly verified. Learn more about our team and our 20+ years of marketing expertise.

faqs.question: How important is it to have a Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Having a claimed Google Business Profile is essential to business success. An optimized profile impacts visibility in Google Search and Maps, builds trust and credibility with potential customers, and drives more foot traffic to your website. Combine it with pay-per-click advertising to dominate both organic and paid search results.

faqs.question: How can I get more reviews on my Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: We help you implement review generation strategies and respond professionally to all reviews. A strong review profile works hand-in-hand with social media management and PPC campaigns to build trust online.
